stem:
Zachary is buying 4 tires for his car. The table shows the prices and the advertised sales for the same type of tire at 4 tire stores.

Tire Store Sales

| Store | Price per Tire | Advertised Sale |
|-------|----------------|-----------------|
| R     | $150           | Buy 3 tires and get the 4th tire free |
| S     | $200           | Buy 4 tires and receive $70 off the price of each tire |
| T     | $175           | Buy 4 tires and receive $200 off the total price |
| V     | $130           | Buy 4 tires and receive 10% off the total price |
instruction: Based on the advertised sales, at which store will Zachary get the lowest price on 4 tires?
visual_elements: Table with columns: Store, Price per Tire, Advertised Sale for stores R, S, T, V
